# Home-screen widget

Jetpack Glance widget, about 60% opaque, showing today's plan, goals and top 3 reads. Checkboxes update state and titles open links. Refreshes on changes and hourly.

## [behavior.md](behavior.md): Widget refresh and interactions (47 lines)

AgentWidget collects the repository StateFlow. Repository updates call updateAll, and the system refreshes it hourly, so the new day's plan can appear up to an hour after midnight.

## [config.md](config.md): Widget size and transparency (33 lines)

Background is 0x99FFFFFF by day and 0x99121212 by night, about 60% opaque. Default size is 4x3 cells and resizable. Change the first two hex digits to adjust opacity.
